text:
elaine_cs: Heads up — CobaltHealth's data platform team pinged me this morning. They're asking to fold 3 separate analytics teams into one flow for real-time triage summarization. They want lower tail latency and streaming summarization for new incoming patient notes. :eyes:
ramon_se: Nice, that's a fairly different workload than their current nightly batch. Do we have any historical qps/seqlen for them?
elaine_cs: Shared this in the ticket https://redwood.example.com/t/COLT-789 — current hosted usage is spiking: 6k requests/day -> 18k, peak qps ~22. They said "we will likely double that in 6 weeks".
eng-sre-bot: Capacity alert: customer CobaltHealth projected qps growth +150% over 30d. Suggested: review dedicated pod options and streaming SLOs.
ravi_ae: If they double we'll cross the free tier threshold and this is likely upsell to Dedicated. @mike_csm can you confirm pricing corridor + committed pods?
mike_csm: Yep — I've sketched two paths: small Dedicated 4x V100 equivalent or keep hosted with aggressive batching/kv cache + per-call caching. I'll add numbers to the ticket by EOD.
sophie_onboard: Enablement note: they'll need a short runbook for streaming responses, sample client retry logic, and a 45min workshop for their infra and analytics leads. I can run the workshop next Wed. :calendar:
ramon_se: Also recommend sampling and evals on summaries — we should avoid regression when switching quantized variants. Suggest a canary with 10% traffic, roll to 50% after perf checks.
elaine_cs: Renewal note: contract up in 3 months. This is an expansion opportunity but also a risk if latency spikes. Let's get an enablement + capacity plan in next 7 days.
mike_csm: I'll draft proposal and pricing. If we get their agreement for Dedicated we'll schedule a pre-migration perf test. ETA: proposal draft tomorrow.
sophie_onboard: I'll prep workshop slides and a small prompt-eval set. Anyone have existing prompt sets for medical triage summarization we can reuse?
ramon_se: I'll share the internal "clinical-summaries" eval pack. Also, ops: we'll need to reserve two pods for the perf test window.
elaine_cs: Thanks team — adding checklist to the ticket. Quick ask: @eng-sre-bot can we get preliminary capacity delta estimate and estimated time to reserve pods?
eng-sre-bot: Ack. Generating estimate, should post numbers within 2h.
elaine_cs: :thumbsup:
